rules.name: Potion of Rat Form
rules.description:
Height 1 only
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
During any friendly Magic Phase, the bearer can choose to lose Attached (if they had it) and perform a Magical Move (6 Mob). 
It must end this move by joining another friendly unit (following the normal rules for joining units).

rules.name: Favanite Powder
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
When casting a Hex spell, after seeing the result of the roll, the bearer can choose to gain Maniacal Enthusiasm (Casting Roll).

rules.name: Plague-Hermit's Blessing
rules.description: The model’s number of HP is set to 6, it gains the Cult of Errahman property, and automatically fails all its Armour Saves rolls.

rules.name: Sacred Aquila
rules.description:
The bearer and Rank-and-File models in the bearer’s unit gain Fury. 
In addition, for each to-hit roll of ‘1’ with a Melee Attack made by the bearer or a Rank-and-File model in its unit, the bearer’s unit suffers 1 hit with Str 3, AP 0 and Unmodifiable at the end of the Agility Step in which this effect is triggered.

rules.name: Bell of the Deep Roads
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains Ambush (Terrain Feature with a friendly Tunnel Marker).

rules.name: Rodentium Bullets
rules.description: Range 18", Shots 3, AP 3, Accurate.

rules.name: Storm Rocket
rules.description:
Aim 3+, Range 24", Str 5, AP 2, Flaming Attacks, Maniacal Enthusiasm (To-Hit Roll).
If the weapon hits, it causes D6 hits instead of 1.

rules.name: Secrets of the Doom Blade
rules.description:
Height 1-3 only
+1 Att, +2 AP. Maniacal Enthusiasm (To-wound roll),Multiple Wounds (D3). 
Rolls this model makes on the Maniacal Enthusiasm chart gain a +2 modifier.

rules.name: Swarm Master
rules.description:
Height 1 only
While using this weapon, the wielder gains Grind Attack (X, Str 3, AP 1,Unmodifiable), where X is the number of Proper Ranks in the wielder’s unit, up to a maximum of 10.

rules.name: Tome of the Ratking
rules.description: The bearer’s unit gains Unstable.

rules.name: Tarina's Lyre
rules.description: Any Stomp Attack made by enemy units within 8" of the bearer suffers a -2 to-wound modifier.

rules.name: Crown of Hubris
rules.description:
At the start of any friendly Magic Phase, the bearer may choose to inflict 3 HP losses on its unit.
 If so, the bearer gains Channel (2) Duration: One Phase.

rules.name: Scepter of the Usurper
rules.description:
The bearer’s unit gains Fearless. 
If the General is removed as a casualty, the bearer becomes the General. 
If the slain General was a Ruinous Dictator, the bearer also sets their Discipline to 9. Duration: Permanent.

rules.name: Darkstone Detonator
rules.description: At the end of any friendly Movement Phase after the first, the bearer may remove all friendly Tunnel Markers placed on a single Terrain Feature within 24" of the bearer. If so, one Unengaged unit in contact with that Terrain Feature suffers 2D6 hits with Str 4, AP 1, and Unmodifiable.

rules.name: Girded by Acratos
rules.description: The model's Armour is set to 4, it gains Magic Resistance (2) and Metal Armour.

rules.name: Enlightened by Favana
rules.description:
The model replaces Wizard Apprentice with Wizard Adept, and can choose Witchcraft,Thaumaturgy instead of Occultism. 
The model cannot take Paired Weapons, Halberd, Great Weapon.

rules.name: Fortified by Udius
rules.description: The model gains Regeneration (4+), Hard Target (1).

rules.name: Pontifex Maximus
rules.description: The model may take (and pay the price for) one item from Artefacts or Potions and Scrolls, worth up to 50 pts, that is normally available to Vermin Swarm Characters.

rules.name: I am the Senate
rules.description: When calculating Combat Score for Combats containing one or more friendly unit within 12" of a Ruinous Dictator, your side adds +1 to their Combat Score.

rules.name: Lord of the Legions
rules.description: The Ruinous Dictator’s model part’s Standard Melee Attacks gains Multiple Wounds (D3).

sharedRules.name: Imperator
sharedRules.description: Other friendly within units range of the model’s Commanding Presence gain Fearless, Unstable.

sharedRules.name: Fetthis Fleshmaster
sharedRules.description: The Charge Range rolls of units entirely with Mutant within 12" one or more Fetthis Fleshmaster gains Maximised.

sharedRules.name: Stygian Overseer
sharedRules.description:
Ambush (Terrain Feature with a friendly Tunnel Marker),Tunnel Digger. 
In addition, each Stygian Overseer on the Army List increases the duplication limit of Legionary Drill Teams by 1.

sharedRules.name: Rakachit Technocrat
sharedRules.description: The model gains Engineer (Experimental Weapon Teams, Vermin Artillery).

sharedRules.name: Skorchit Alchemist
sharedRules.description:
Shooting Attacks from the model with a Pistol gain Flaming Attacks. 
In addition, Height 1 Rank-and-File models in the bearer’s unit benefits from 
 First Strike (Zeal, Flaming Attacks).

sharedRules.name: Pestilent Pulpit
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Diseased, Exclusive (Plague Cultists). 
The model’s unit gains Poison Attacks. 
The Chassis model part’s Agility is set to 4 and it gains Grind Attack (D3+1), Devastating Charge (+10 Agi).

sharedRules.name: Whispering Bell
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Musician, Exclusive (Blackfur Veterans, Vermin Legionaries), and the Chassis Model part gains Impact Hits (D3+1) 
Increase the number of ignored Health Points due to Life is Cheap by two in Combats where at least one friendly unit containing Life is Cheap is within 12" of the Whispering Bell. 
 Remember that Unit Boundaries are frozen until after taking Break Tests.

sharedRules.name: Bloodfur Praetorian
sharedRules.description: The model gains Bodyguard (General), and the Blackfur Veteran model part gains Great Weapon, and loses Halberd.

sharedRules.name: Gladius
sharedRules.description: The model part gains +1 Str when using a Hand Weapon.

sharedRules.name: Cannon Fodder
sharedRules.description: Shooting Attacks towards enemy units in contact with one or more models with Cannon Fodder gain +1 to hit.

sharedRules.name: Furs on Fire!
sharedRules.description: Immediately before the model is removed as a casualty as a result of an enemy Melee Attack, it inflicts 1 hit with Str 3, AP 0, Flaming Attacks, Unmodifiable towards the Health Pool of the model that caused the wound.

sharedRules.name: Plague Flail
sharedRules.description: Halberd, Grind Attack (1, Toxic Attacks)

sharedRules.name: Plague Disciples
sharedRules.description: The unit replaces its Bloodpox Blades with Plague Flail.

sharedRules.name: Deepfire Grenades
sharedRules.description:
AimRangeShotsStrAP58262
Attack Attributes: Accurate, Flaming Attacks, Quick to Fire, Deepfire Grenades
When shooting at an enemy unit Engaged in Combat (using the Callous rule), hits are distributed onto a randomly chosen friendly unit Engaged with the original target on a roll of 5+ instead of 4+.

sharedRules.name: Unit of Artillery
sharedRules.description: If one model in this unit is affected by an Engineer, all Rank-and-File models in this unit are affected by the Engineer.

sharedRules.name: Unstable Engines
sharedRules.description: Immediately before the model is removed as a casualty, it inflicts D6 hits with Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks, Unmodifiable on all units, other than its own, within 6" of the model’s unit.

sharedRules.name: Underworld Beast
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Random Movement (3D6").
 It loses the Pitmaster model part, and its base size is changed to 60×100 mm. 
 The Arena Beast model parts Attack Value is set to 4D3.

sharedRules.name: Tunnel Digger
sharedRules.description:
Each Vermin Swarm army gains one Tunnel Marker, and an additional Tunnel Marker for each unit on the Army List with Tunnel Digger. 
During Pre-game Selections, for each of your army’s Tunnel Markers, mark a Terrain Feature with a Tunnel Marker. 
Only Terrain Features that are not in contact with the opponent’s Deployment Zone can be marked. Note: Impassable Terrain can be chosen.

sharedRules.name: Callous
sharedRules.description:
The model may use Shooting Attacks towards enemy units Engaged in Combat, with the following rules and restrictions: 
 • Friendly units Engaged in this Combat are ignored for Cover purposes (but not for drawing Line of Sight). 
 • Roll to-hit as normal against the intended target. Immediately after determining the number of hits, roll a D6 for each hit. On a roll of 4+, the hit is distributed onto a randomly chosen friendly unit Engaged with the original target. Otherwise, proceed as normal.

sharedRules.name: Drill Down!
sharedRules.description:
One use only. 
At the beginning of Vanguard Units (Battle Setup, 3.F), a unit containing Drill Down! may choose to be removed from the Battlefield. If so, the unit gains Ambush (Terrain Feature with a friendly Tunnel Marker).
.

sharedRules.name: Life is Cheap
sharedRules.description:
When calculating Combat Score, ignore the first two Health Point losses of Health Pools with Life is Cheap in each Round of Combat. 
 Note: the number of ignored Health Point losses is not affected by the amount of Health Pools. 
 Units containing Life is Cheap that are both Steady and Solid get +2 Discipline when taking Break Tests.

sharedRules.name: Cutting Corners
sharedRules.description: The model selects one spell less than normal.

sharedRules.name: Cohort Coordination
sharedRules.description:
While the unit has a Standard Bearer and the General is on the Battlefield, it: 
 • Gains Fight in Extra Rank. 
 • May reroll a failed Command Test. If it chooses to do this, and still fails the test, the unit loses Standard Bearer, and you must remove one Rank-and-File model from the unit as a casualty (no saves allowed).

sharedRules.name: Tracking Telescope
sharedRules.description: The model gains +1 to hit towards targets with Hard Target that are at Long Range.

sharedRules.name: Maniacal Enthusiasm
sharedRules.description:
When models in a unit make a dice roll of the type defined in brackets (X), after seeing the result(s) of all simultaneous rolls for X, and rolling eventual re-rolls, it may add 2 to X for all simultaneous rolls with this attribute.
 If this modifier is used, immediately roll a D6 and consult the table below: 
 • 1--2 Oops: Change the target of all simultaneous Attacks or a spell with Maniacal Enthusiasm to a friendly unit within range chosen by the controlling player (the model’s own unit is always an eligible target). 
 • 3--4 Room for Improvement: After fully resolving the simultaneous attacks or a spell that triggered the roll on this table, the model’s unit suffers 3 hits with Str 4, AP 10 and Unmodifiable. 
 • 5--6 Glorious Success!: No additional effect.

sharedRules.name: Diseased
sharedRules.description: For each Standard Melee Attack allocated against a model with Diseased that rolls a to-hit roll of ‘1’, the attacking model's Health Pool suffers 1 hit with Toxic Attacks at the end of the same Agility Step.

sharedRules.name: Deepfire Thrower
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Weakness (Flaming Attacks). 
Only one model per unit may use a Deepfire Thrower in any one Shooting Phase. 
Increase the Aim of the Deepfire Thrower by 1 for each other model in the unit armed with a Deepfire Thrower.

sharedRules.name: Canister Launcher
sharedRules.description:
Only one model per unit may use a Canister Launcher in any one Shooting Phase. 
Increase the Aim of the Canister Launcher by 1 for each other model in the unit armed with a Canister Launcher.

sharedRules.description: Paired Weapons. Poison Attacks.
